Based in NYC and Austin, we're on a mission to modernize the dental supply chain and revenue cycle — helping practices save time, reduce costs, and improve profitability through software that transforms critical parts of their business. Torch Revenue Cycle Management — an agentic AI insurance platform launching this year that solves one of dentistry's biggest pain points: helping practices get paid faster and more accurately by insurance providers, using technology that's long underserved this space.
